decisions.reason: As a newly launched core-line garage door operator with its own web page, it fits the firm's main range and a large firm with slack has little reason to withdraw it absent clear underperformance.
The solid wood sectional garage door is a more niche offer, but it supports the firm's customization strategy and there is no sign yet of results far enough below aspiration to trigger withdrawal.

This remote-control garage door operator is closely related to the firm's established garage access business, so management would likely continue it while learning about demand rather than reallocate resources immediately.

Although only mentioned rather than heavily featured and facing overlap with other industrial door variants, it still matches the firm's industrial portfolio and would likely be retained unless early sales disappointed clearly.
The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits customer demand for compliant thermal and industrial solutions, making it likely to be kept while the firm assesses its early market acceptance.

Being presented on its own page suggests stronger commitment and visibility, and in a large German metal-products firm this kind of strategically aligned industrial door would usually be given more time before any exit decision.
